test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ______________ government launched Dayanand Social Security Scheme 2022 for senior citizens, single women, disabled persons and HIV/AIDS patients.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Goa.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa government** has launched Dayanand Social Security Scheme 2022 for senior citizens, single women, disabled persons, and HIV / AIDS patients.
 
• The main objective of the DSSS scheme is to provide financial assistance to the most vulnerable sections of society.
 
• Chief Minister Pramod Sawant, in his budget speech for the year 2021-22, had assured on the floor of the House that financial assistance to widows would be increased by Rs 500 per month. 
 
• While no separate category exists for widows under this scheme, it is included as a sub-category under the head “Single Women”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The scheme was launched in 2022**.__**
